_comment: Registry of every Twig filter / function / test that exists in the TARGET Archipelago
install but is NOT built in to twig/twig. The linter registers these as no-op stubs so
that parsing a template here behaves the same way it does inside Drupal.
FIDELITY RULE: a name missing from this file causes a FALSE FAILURE; a name present here
that the target install does not actually provide causes a FALSE PASS. False passes are
silent, so this registry is deliberately MINIMAL -- it lists what these templates actually
use plus the fully-verified format_strawberryfield set. Before adding a name, confirm it
exists in the deployed site (grep the module source, or check /admin/reports/status).
See README.md -> 'Registry drift' for the maintenance story.
twig_core_note: twig/twig built-ins (json_encode, merge, default, replace, url_encode, round, trim, escape, split, join, date, striptags, first, last, title, lower, number_format, slice, keys, length, raw, attribute, constant, ...) are NOT listed here -- Twig provides them itself.
